column1: # The cut-sweep cases each STORE land runs (sync.py NATIVE_STORE_LAND, tools/corpus --selection store-land).
# One row each, tab-separated: key (a case, or a prefix naming a family's cases), N, and a note naming the
# ruling. A land runs one case of the key and the cuts at positions i % N == s of its declared cuts, both from
# n, the count of commits up to the land's parent: s = n % N, the case the (n // N) % cases'th, so consecutive
# lands take different shares and every (case, share) comes round. Milestones run every family whole.
# `tools/corpus --native --selection store-land --plan` prints the CPU-h these rows plan before anything runs.
